# Blazor WebAssembly Skill

## Purpose

Use this skill for Blazor WebAssembly, Razor routing, MudBlazor, and client-side application changes.

## Rules

- Target .NET 10.
- Keep the application compatible with static hosting.
- Treat Razor pages as client-side UI, not server HTTP endpoints.
- Use MudBlazor consistently with the existing application.
- Keep browser interop isolated and explicit.
- Do not assume ASP.NET Core server middleware exists after deployment.
- Prefer simple components and services over speculative abstractions.
- Keep source documentation in en-US.
